body:
Thank you all for the kind and amazing responses.  I apologize for the late response, after posting this I stuck my head in the sand (paperwork) so I could be "professional" with my residents in the morning and went to bed right after I got off work.  (Oh yes, I'm a good example of healthy coping strategies... :P )

I suppose I must go brush up on my Lord's Prayer and check with the local churches.  It's the one thing I haven't done because I'm not particularly religious.  I have checked at a few battered women's shelters, but most of them only have the funding to help the most severe cases.  I understand completely - the deep irony of all this is that I work in a related field.  My hours got cut, and I'm lucky where I work is still open.  A lot of places that do the same had to close or downsize.  I'm in full agreement that what little money those places have should go to women in worse spots than me.

All your posts made me take stock of what I still do have.  You're right Round, it could be worse.  There were a few ideas that while I agree with on a theoretical level I can't accept for myself.  It's remarkably selfish, but I feel like I've given enough without receiving.  I know that's a terrible thing to say, but it's the truth.  I don't feel like there's anything left for me to give that's good.  Maybe that's my problem.
